Blue lines: rays · Red line: retinal plane · Green dot: focus. The incoming and outgoing segments are drawn at different scales.
P = 1/dₒ + 1/dᵢ\nOffset = dᵢ − 17 mm\nNegative offset: before the retinal plane. Positive offset: behind it. The lens equation uses metres; 1 D = 1 m⁻¹.

One ideal thin lens in air represents the combined optics of the cornea and lens. The model retinal plane is fixed at 17 mm. It omits individual anatomy, optical aberrations and neural processing. The power shown is neither a diagnosis nor a lens prescription.
